admitted.why: Adds a guided but inspectable 64-module recipe Studio with recursive composites, promoted controls, dependency graphs, snapshots, undo, redo, and bounded repair.
Adds raw-before-normalized review, required SHA-256 package integrity, cycle and size limits, built-in replacement protection, and transactional import without package-supplied code.
Adds dependency-free Node and browser runtimes plus a local validate, compile, and inspect CLI without requiring the Studio UI.
Adds one canonical resolved-visual-intent contract and per-operation implemented, approximated, contract-only, or unsupported accounting.
Adds reduced-motion, high-contrast, large-text, photosensitive-safe, quality-fallback, load-estimation, and frame-history controls with explicit evidence limits.
Adds bundled Web, Web Component, CSS token, static SVG, Godot Theme, Unity UI Toolkit, and generic-game contract routes with their approximation boundaries intact.

relationships.boundary: The existing fifteen deterministic CSS/SVG/token blocks remain the small portable primitive owner; translation into AetherFX modules requires an explicit reviewed adapter.
UI-FX remains the removable class recipe owner; AetherFX owns dependency-aware scene recipes and never applies either system to a host automatically.
Aetherglass retains direct platform composition and rollback authority; AetherFX intent may be mapped only through a reviewed adapter and explicit application gate.
Style Fabric remains the token and skin owner; AetherFX CSS tokens are candidate inputs, not an instruction to rewrite or activate a skin.
SVG previews, HTML components, JSON intent, and engine starter files remain candidate artifacts subject to the receiving canvas and target renderer verification.

not_admitted_as_authority: automatic mutation of visual-fx UI-FX Style Fabric Aetherglass or product surfaces
native Unity Unreal Godot Blender After Effects WebGL PBR or mobile renderer parity
universal shader compilation or physically exact optical simulation
public ownership consent licence or redistribution rights
automatic appearance approval activation promotion or canon status

platform_patch.reason: The inventory generator compared POSIX report suffixes directly with native absolute paths. On Windows, rerunning verification therefore included all four generated inventory reports and produced an impossible SHA256SUMS self-entry.
platform_patch.effect: Inventory filtering now normalizes paths before applying the generated-report exclusion, and the regression guard requires all four reports to remain outside the checksum set.

evidence_boundary.upstream: The source archive reported 35 passing Node tests and retained packaged Chromium evidence. Its original 170-entry checksum set is preserved at UPSTREAM_SHA256SUMS.txt.
evidence_boundary.local: The isolated source was rebuilt and passed 35 tests before integration. The patched capsule must pass 36 Node tests, runtime and CLI proofs, checksum comparison, discovery generation, and a new live browser observation before review.
evidence_boundary.browser: Packaged browser images and reports remain upstream evidence only; the Workshop intake records a separate local browser observation.
